import { mdxGuideMetadata } from './mdx-metadata'

/** Maintained group order; body/frontmatter ownership stays in each MDX file. */
export const mdxGuideGroups = ['getting-started', 'guides', 'customize'] as const
export function allMdxGuideMetadata() {
  return mdxGuideGroups.flatMap(group => mdxGuideMetadata(group))
}
